items.title: Commission IND-20260807-3: independent re-run against v1.2.0, attempting the digests
items.hypothesis: With every hashed byte registered (R5.1/R5.2), the independent implementation reproduces C11's and C12's contentDigest byte-for-byte -- the first cross-implementation digest agreement in the program.
items.discriminatingTest: Byte comparison against the pinned digests; on a miss, the fixtures' canonical strings localise the first divergent byte. Conclusion distribution and zero-violation checks as before.
items.whyItMatters: Closes the F10 -> R4 -> G2 -> R5.1 arc; makes I4/I6 cross-implementation properties; completes the substance of KL-011's two-implementation prerequisite; makes verified-independent claimable by owner promotion.
items.wouldChangeWhat: Pass: verified-independent promotion decision reaches the owner, KL-011 preregistration unblocks. Fail: byte offset localises the next repair.
items.cost: repo-side: one package-preparation commit under the registered packaging requirements (see NEXT-RUN-PROPOSAL). Commission-side: implementer time; one-line fixture loader change plus the receipt-object adoption.
items.supersedes: BL-013; incorporates BL-019 as registered requirements

items.committedGate: The I12 half of this item is a COMMITTED v1.3.0 gate (owner direction, RUN-20260807-3 close; evidence and exact pass condition in KL-000 STATUS.json committedGates), not an optional backlog idea. It appears here for sequencing only; dropping it would require an owner decision recorded as such.
items.title: v1.3.0 bundle: I12 conclusion enforcement, world-referential I2/I5, baseline dedup + B6, stream registration
items.hypothesis: Adding I12 (conclusion == conclusionFunction(world)) gives the checker power over the conclusion function (closing G4/SPEC-110, subsuming I2's and I5's conclusion clauses); restating I2/I5 world-referentially closes F1/F2; B2/B3 dedup plus a B6 that drops opposingRoots closes F3 and the I5 power gap; registering a draw schedule or worldStreamHash closes F11. None should move a reference number; same exact-equality discipline.
items.discriminatingTest: The existential-reading ablation (this run's verified G4 probe) must be caught by I12 on 22,440 worlds with no fixture involved; B2 must fail registered I2 as literally read; B6 must be caught only by world-referential I5; two implementations must produce identical worldStreamHash values.
items.whyItMatters: G4 is the structural defect that produced the original 22,440-world divergence, still intact; F1 is a registered must-fail baseline not failing its registered invariant. KL-011 inherits every one of these holes.
items.prerequisitesNote: SEQUENCED AFTER BL-020 -- the commission target stays frozen while the implementer works (third application of the rule).
items.absorbs: BL-014, BL-015 (residual: F13 note correction, F14, NAM-101 vocabulary unification), BL-016, BL-017, BL-018

items.title: Commission packages carry their own digest manifest, and package preparation is a checklisted derivation
items.hypothesis: A package manifest (file list + digests, prepared at delivery) plus a derivation checklist (delete prediction sections; screen every file, both number formats; verify registered paths resolve) prevents the LEAK-101 and G6 classes.
items.discriminatingTest: Apply to the BL-020 package: the checklist must mechanically catch a planted prediction table in any shipped file and a planted non-resolving path, before delivery.
items.whyItMatters: LEAK-101 was traceable only because the operator happened to preserve both package states; a manifest makes that guaranteed rather than lucky. Third instance of a screening check passing on the wrong scope (PROV-004, the v1.0.0 artifacts list, LEAK-101).
items.cost: one checklist + one script; runs at package preparation

items.title: Harness-side prompt capture (PROV-004/008/009, three consecutive runs)
items.hypothesis: The runtime harness writing delivered prompt bytes to disk before the agent starts eliminates the agent-transcription caveat that has marked every run manifest in this program.
items.discriminatingTest: A run whose manifest carries promptCaptureMethod operator-file or harness-capture with a digest computed before the session.
items.whyItMatters: Three runs, three unverified prompt digests. The fix is environmental and cannot be produced by any run for itself.
items.prerequisitesNote: requires operator action outside any run
